verdict.rationale: Solid documents Resources for loading server data as reactive state with Suspense, plus full SSR with streaming and progressive hydration and isomorphic components. Together these support fetching data during server rendering and making the components interactive on the client. The evidence does not describe a dedicated async server-component model that passes fetched data into separate client components. missing for 10: explicit async server components with a server/client component boundary, documentation of serializing server-fetched data into hydrated client components, hands-on corroboration of this data flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can fetch data in asynchronous server-rendered components and pass it down to interactive client components

citations.quote: With Resources, you can use data loaded from the server like any other piece of state and build a responsive UI for it thanks to Suspense and concurrent rendering.
Solid has full SSR and serverless support, with streaming and progressive hydration to get to interactive as quickly as possible.
Isomorphic: render your components on the client and the server
Provides modern framework features like JSX, fragments, Context, Portals, Suspense, streaming SSR, progressive hydration, Error Boundaries and concurrent rendering.
